name: City of Chicago Open Data
tagline: Socrata SODA API for City of Chicago open datasets and civic data.
description: Official open data platform for the City of Chicago, powered by Socrata (Tyler Technologies). Exposes hundreds of public datasets—crime, 311, transportation, permits, demographics—via the SODA REST API with JSON/CSV access. Developers query datasets by resource ID with filtering, paging, and SoQL. An app token is recommended for higher rate limits; many reads work without authentication.

auth.details: Optional Socrata app token via X-App-Token header (or $$app_token query param); self-serve from portal profile. Without a token, lower throttling applies. No OAuth required for public reads.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public data free; app token recommended for higher throughput. Exact free quotas not published as a fixed daily allotment.

rate_limits: Without app token: lower shared IP-based throttling. With app token: ordinarily not throttled except for abuse/malicious traffic controls (no fixed published hourly quota). Exact Chicago-specific numbers not always published.
use_cases: query Chicago crime incidents by date or type
list building permits or business licenses
get CTA or traffic-related open datasets
export neighborhood or demographic tables as JSON/CSV
